examples.arabic: أحمد كان شاب صغير وكان عايز يبقى فنان مشهور.
examples.english: Ahmed was a young man and he wanted to become a famous artist.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed kan shabb soghayyar we kan ayiz yib-a fannan mash-hoor.

examples.arabic: الشاب قال مفيش وقت للاكل ونزل الشارع
examples.english: The young man said there is no time for food and went down to the street
examples.transliteration: El shab aal mafeesh waet lel akl wa nezel el sharea

examples.arabic: فجأة خبطت في شاب ماشي بسرعة، فقالها الشاب بابتسامة: "السلام عليكم، معلش يا أستاذة."
examples.english: Suddenly she bumped into a young man walking quickly, and the young man said to her with a smile: "Peace be upon you, excuse me, madam."
examples.transliteration: Fa-ga'a khabṭet fi shabb mashi be-sor3a, fa-2alha el-shabb be-ebtesama: "As-salamu 3alaykum, ma3lesh ya ostaza."
examples.storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

examples.arabic: سألت شاب صغير ازاي اروح محطة المترو قالي امشي شمال عند المول الجديد
examples.english: I asked a young man how to get to the metro station, he told me to go left at the new mall.
examples.transliteration: Sa'alt shabb soghayar ezay aroo7 ma7attet el metro, qali emshi shemal 3and el mall el gedid.

examples.arabic: رد الشاب بابتسامة واسعة، أهلاً بيكي يا منى! أنا كويس خالص الحمد لله، بس إيه اللي جابك هنا الجو حر جدا دلوقتي؟
examples.english: The young man replied with a wide smile, "Welcome, Mona! I'm perfectly fine, thank God, but what brought you here? The weather is very hot now!"
examples.transliteration: Radd el-shabb be-ebtesama wase3a, "Ahlan beiki ya Mona! Ana kwayyes khales el-hamdolellah, bas eih elly gabek hena el-gaww harr geddan delwa'ty?"
examples.storyTitle: Greetings in the Bustle of Khan el-Khalili

examples.arabic: جنبه شاب صغير ماسك موبايله وبيشوف فيديوهات على التيك توك
examples.english: Next to him, a young man was holding his phone and watching videos on TikTok.
examples.transliteration: Gambo shabb ṣoghāyar māsek mobaylo w byeshūf fīdyohāt ʿala et-Tīk Tok
